ml.title: Machine Learning Topics
ml.subtitle: Explore various algorithms and concepts in Machine Learning.

pca.title: PCA
pca.desc: Principal Component Analysis for dimensionality reduction.

kmeans.title: K-Means
kmeans.desc: Clustering algorithm to partition data into K distinct groups.

naive_bayes.title: Naive Bayes
naive_bayes.desc: Probabilistic classifier based on Bayes' theorem.

logistic_regression.title: Logistic Regression
logistic_regression.desc: Statistical model used for binary classification.

svm.title: SVM
svm.desc: Support Vector Machines for robust classification and regression.

sampling.title: Sampling Techniques
sampling.subtitle: Discover scientific methods to select representative samples from large populations.

simple_random.title: Simple Random Sampling
simple_random.desc: Every individual in the population has an exactly equal chance of being selected.

stratified.title: Stratified Sampling
stratified.desc: Splits the population into key subgroups (strata) and samples from each proportionally.

systematic.title: Systematic Sampling
systematic.desc: Selects elements at a regular, fixed mathematical interval from an ordered list.

cluster.title: Cluster Sampling
cluster.desc: Divides population into natural clusters, then randomly chooses entire clusters to study.

about.title: About KaSao
about.subtitle: An educational and interactive web portal for Machine Learning and Sampling science.
about.intro: KaSao was built to bridge the gap between academic formulas and visual intuition. By combining rigorous mathematics with modern, interactive simulations, we make complex data concepts accessible and engaging.
about.ml_desc: Explore core algorithms (PCA, K-Means, Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, SVM) with detailed theoretical frameworks, formula derivations, and step-by-step explanations.
about.sampling_desc: Configure population sizes, stratify groupings, define step intervals, and visualize random cluster selections in real-time using custom HTML5 canvas simulators.
about.academic_desc: Review clear mathematical definitions. From Cochrane's formula to Neyman Allocation and Design Effects, all formulas are rendered in high-fidelity LaTeX.
about.ui_desc: Experience a premium editorial interface with particle physics backgrounds, responsive dark/light/cinematic modes, and smooth micro-animations.
about.tech_desc: Built with modern software architecture to ensure speed, accessibility, and clean design patterns.
about.tech_frontend_details: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion for premium web layout and animations.
about.tech_backend_details: FastAPI (Python 3.12+), SQLAlchemy ORM, SQLite database for high-performance API endpoint services.
